name: Spool Control
description: Web application for managing 3D printing filament spools. Track stock, weight, color, brand and material. Generate QR-coded 60x40mm labels, print directly to Niimbot printers via Web Bluetooth, and record weighings from automatic stations. Multi-user with role-based access and multilingual UI (PT/EN/ES).

notes.text: Admin password is auto-generated and stored in /opt/spool-control/.admin-pass inside the container.
Set APP_BASE_URL in /opt/spool-control/spool.env (or via Admin > Settings) to your public domain for QR codes to work outside the local network.
